newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian lev closes flat at 210-212 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian lev closes flat at 210-212 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed between 210 and 212 per dollar, unchanged from morning levels, after very thin interbank forex trade in the absence of large end clients, dealers said.
"The market was listless with the lev idling between 210-212 throughout the day as some banks bid for small dollar volumes, probably for position squaring," a commercial bank dealer said.

Some dealers said there were sporadic deals at 213 levs per dollar, but generally pressure on the lev was low compared to Thursday's hectic trade. "No big dollar buyers emerged in the market today and the lev took a breath," another dealer said.
On Thursday, a big fuel importer bid for some $2 million, pushing the lev down to 211 to the dollar from an opening rate round 205.
The lev has declined against the dollar throughout August, after starting the month around 187.
